source_evidence: Day328~13:25 exact player 'I will come' accepts accompanying Desen for a discreet voluntary approach to Berric Sornell, not an immediate public confrontation, promise, payment or signed agreement. Desen advises preserving V's cover and sends a plainclothes Watch messenger to privately invite Sornell to speak with Desen and V about his concerns in a neutral private room, without announcing the investigation to other workers; ordinary actual messenger contact with Sornell at storehouse1 is completed and messenger returns to annex. Before roll DM fixed independent willingness d20:1–5 declines,6–10 requests assurances first,11–20 agrees to private conversation. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch e7bb13d636abbe6699ce63b674de13cf d20 face6: Sornell does not yet accept interview and sends reply asking whether he can speak without being publicly identified, whether he is free to leave afterward, and what happens to his promised settlement. He has not confessed, resigned, agreed to testify, surrendered records, or claimed a specific threat. Desen states that he can arrange a confidential voluntary interview and consider lawful witness protection if there is a credible danger, but cannot promise immunity, conceal evidence from a court, or guarantee payment of Sornell's private settlement. Desen asks whether V has anything to add before he sends those assurances. No additional messenger dispatch yet, no actual interview or guaranteed protection, no new financial commitment, no transfer of records, no Harthvale knowledge or alarm established. Ordinary elapsed time only; no new expenditure or resource change. V chooses next action.
